<h1 class="hero-title">Shale Network</h1>

::: {.intro-lead}
Building a national water-quality database for oil- and gas-producing regions.
:::

Our data extend beyond Pennsylvania. We are broadening coverage across the United States, building on records from the northeastern U.S. Marcellus region.

We bring together water-quality records from community groups, agencies, industry, and researchers to support research, teaching, and comparisons across places and dates.

## Working with water data

### Research
Groundwater and stream-water records support studies of methane, salinity, and water chemistry. [Explore published examples](database/data-highlights.qmd).

### Teaching
Use water chemistry to investigate methane sources and brine disposal, or practice data analysis in R and Python. [Find teaching materials](education/index.qmd).

### Community
The workshop archive brings together agendas, presentations, and discussions from researchers, agencies, industry, and community groups. [Browse workshop materials](events/index.qmd).

[Meet the team](people/people.qmd){.section-link}
:::
